      "body": "`record_for_host` performs `where(\"lower(host) = ?\", host).first` on every embed request. findings.title: Migration crashes when embed_category has no matching category
findings.body: The expression `execute("SELECT ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id']` assumes at least one row is returned. If the `embed_category` site setting is blank or points to a non-existent category name (common default is empty), the query returns no rows, `[0]` is nil, and calling `['id']` raises NoMethodError. This aborts the migration and prevents deployment.

findings.title: SQL injection in migration from site setting value
findings.body: Old `embeddable_hosts` values are interpolated directly into a raw INSERT statement: `VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`. If a stored host value contains a single quote or other SQL metacharacters, the migration can fail or potentially execute arbitrary SQL. Use parameterized inserts or ActiveRecord create! instead.

findings.title: before_validation crashes on nil host
findings.body: `self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` is called in a `before_validation` callback. If `host` is nil (e.g., an admin request omits the host parameter), `sub!` raises NoMethodError instead of allowing validation to fail gracefully. The controller relies on model validation to report errors, so this will result in a 500 error rather than a validation error.

findings.title: Missing 404 handling for update and destroy
findings.body: Both `update` (line 10) and `destroy` (line 15) retrieve `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` without checking for nil. If the id does not exist, `save_host(nil)` or `host.destroy` raises NoMethodError, causing a 500 error. The controller should respond with a 404 JSON error for missing records.

findings.title: Missing index for embeddable host lookup causes full table scan
findings.body: `record_for_host` performs `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` on every embed request. There is no index on the `host` column, so PostgreSQL must scan the entire `embeddable_hosts` table for each comment embed or topic retrieval. This can become a significant performance bottleneck on high-traffic forums. Add an index on `lower(host)` or store hosts downcased with a normal index.

findings.title: Plural _ids hydration can crash on null values
findings.body: The new plural `_ids` handling calls `obj[k].map(...)` without checking that `obj[k]` is an array. If any REST payload contains a `*_ids` key set to null (rather than an array), this will throw `Cannot read property 'map' of null`, breaking model hydration. The previous code only matched singular `_id` and did not have this risk. Guard with `Array.isArray(obj[k])` or default to an empty array.

findings.title: Pretender /fruits/:id always returns the first fruit
findings.body: The route `/fruits/:id` always returns `fruits[0]`, regardless of the requested id. The test `store-test.js.es6` calls `store.find('fruit', 2)` and then asserts the presence of color_ids [1,2], but those belong to fruit id 1. The test would pass even if the store returned the wrong record by id. The route should return the fruit matching `request.params.id` to make the test meaningful.
